title: Untamed Earthy Canadian Bison Skewers
description: A hearty and earthy Canadian dish featuring bison, perfect for a date night, with the bold flavors of red wine vinegar and the char of a yakimono-grill, all made possible on a gluten-free friendly tava-griddle.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill or tava-griddle to medium-high heat, ensuring it reaches a safe temperature for cooking.
In a large bowl, whisk together red wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the bison cubes to the marinade, toss to coat, cover the bowl with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated bison, onion, and mushrooms onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece for even cooking.
Place the skewers on the preheated yakimono-grill or tava-griddle and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the bison reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Once cooked, remove the skewers from the heat and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional thyme and rosemary if desired.
For an added earthy flavor, serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a simple green salad.
